papers.title: Machine learning enables full Bayesian inference for spinning extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; Extended Data: 4 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary: Generative networks plus exact LISA-Taiji likelihood produce first 14-parameter posterior for a spinning extreme-mass-ratio inspiral from the complete prior.

papers.title: Learning to find cosmic filaments with graph neural networks
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, accepted at Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences 2026 workshop
papers.summary: Flow matching with graph neural networks generates probabilistic cosmic filament configurations from galaxy surveys, reproducing target statistics and modeling uncertainty.

papers.title: Symbolic Regression Diagnostics of 1D Lyman Alpha Forest Emulator
papers.summary: Symbolic regression with a Sobolev derivative-matching loss recovers derivative-faithful equations for 9 of 11 Lyman-alpha forest emulator parameters at z=3.6.
